text: FAA guidance states that when the connection cannot be reestablished, emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link should be started per AC 107-2A. It also directs trying to reestablish the control link and includes a preflight control link loss procedure. Manual evidence for the Matrice 30T is not found in this collection. Unverified incident reports state RTH at programmed altitude, including back-to-back hops, and a separate note that RTH initiated but did not respond when attempted. Gaps: no verified evidence that the Matrice 30T behavior matches the manual after loss of link, and claims of interference near the antenna lack official guidance in this collection.
